text:
maya_ks: heads up — Taproot SI flagged 3 inbound marketplace leads stuck in intake >72h. they tried to claim but SF auto-blocked them. :eyes:
nick_s: ugh. do we know why auto-block triggered? are there missing MSA fields?
harper_m: looking — two missing Partner Account mappings, one missing NDA flag. SF rule prevents claim without mapping.
maya_ks: TAP-234 ticket opened with Taproot PM (cc @harper_m). They need a clear handoff window — usually 48h to claim before we route back to AE.
alina_pd: can we shorten to 24h for SI partners on marketplace? their sales cycles are short. also need note on joint announcement timing.
nick_s: proposal: define SLA matrix in parity with partner tier. Tier1 SI = 24h claim window, Tier2 = 48h, Tier3 = 72h. if unclaimed, route back to originating AE and mark as "partner-unclaimed".
partner-bot: automated note: created tag `si_claim_pending` on 3 leads and scheduled escalation in 24h.
harper_m: quick ops ask — need a reliable SF filter we can share with SIs so they know which leads are auto-blocked. current filter: `RecordType = Lead AND LeadSource IN (Marketplace, CloudMarket) AND Partner_Mapped__c = FALSE`
maya_ks: add to that snippet: `AND NDA_Status__c != 'Signed'` — that matches what blocked the third lead.
alina_pd: ok if we accept Nick's SLA matrix can partnerships update the marketplace doc and ping AP for marketplace listing timing? we have a joint-announcement checklist that needs partner PR lead and marketplace listing date aligned +-7 days.
nick_s: i'll update the internal playbook and add a one-line handoff template for AEs to use in SF: `@PartnerOwner: please claim within 24h (Tier1) — else AE escalates to partnership@redwood.com`.
harper_m: ops action: i will add a process in the intake workflow — auto-tag -> 1st reminder (6h) -> escalation (24/48/72h based on tier). will also surface a small report in Console Ops: `si_claim_queue`.
maya_ks: can we run this as a 2-week pilot for Taproot? if it works, roll to all Tier1 SIs.
alina_pd: yes. Taproot PM ok with pilot. also schedule a short joint-PR pre-announce 2 weeks before GA — Taproot wants hardware partner mentions included.
nick_s: noted. next steps: (1) harper to implement tags & report by EOD Friday (2) nick to update playbook and AE template by Monday (3) maya to confirm Taproot pilot start date with their PM.
maya_ks: thanks all — small ask: can partnerships add a checklist item for marketplace listings to include `Private Offer` status? we saw misaligned expectations there last quarter.
harper_m: added to the sprint backlog. will post update in this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
